title: Active Question - Wayfinding
prompt:
Mobile (iPhone 393x852) screen for a single-user NY real estate salesperson exam prep PWA, design concept "Wayfinding": New York transit signage language, quiet native-iOS polish. Dark OLED canvas #090d16, surfaces #111725, raised #182033, 1px hairlines rgba(148,163,184,.16), primary ink #f1f5f9, secondary ink #a3b1c6, go/emerald #10b981 (primary action, correct), stop red #ef4444 (wrong), caution amber #f59e0b (flagged), statute indigo #818cf8 (legal citations and the selected-answer outline only). Type: Helvetica Neue bold with tight tracking for display and numbers (tabular figures), system UI 17px for body. Sentence case everywhere; no all-caps labels, no middle-dot separated meta strings, no arrows on buttons, no gradients, no drop shadows on cards. Radii: 24 sheets, 18 cards, 14 option rows and controls, full pills for bullets. 16px screen gutters.

Layout of the active-question screen, top to bottom:
1. Slim sticky top bar under the iOS status bar, on the canvas with a hairline bottom edge. Row 1: "Q 14 of 75" in bold tabular Helvetica Neue 17px on the left; on the right a timer pill "41:07" (raised #182033 capsule, bold tabular numbers, small clock icon), a 44px bookmark icon button, and a plain text button "Submit" in indigo. Row 2: a line-progress drawn like a subway line map: a 4px rounded track across the full width with small station dots along it; passed stations filled emerald, the current station a larger ringed dot, one earlier station amber because it is flagged, upcoming stations hollow. Row 3: a NYC-subway-style route bullet (26px circle, bold one-character code, white text) paired with the topic name in 15px secondary ink: blue #0039A6 bullet with "E" and "Contracts".
2. The question, large and comfortable to read: 22px Helvetica Neue bold, line-height 1.3, ink color, set directly on the canvas (no box around it), max ~6 lines.
3. Four full-width answer option rows stacked with 10px gaps, each a 14-radius surface (#111725) row at least 60px tall with a 32px rounded-square letter tile (A, B, C, D) on the left and 17px answer text that wraps naturally.
State: Exam mode (timed 75-question mock exam, no right/wrong feedback). Option C is selected: indigo #818cf8 1.5px outline, faint indigo tint, indigo letter tile with white letter; the other three rows neutral. Below the options an open "Question map" sheet (surface #111725, radius 18) whose title row shows "Question map" in bold and "31 of 75 answered" in secondary ink with a chevron. Inside: a compact grid of 75 numbered squares, 8 per row, each 44px tall with radius 10 and tabular numbers: answered squares filled raised #182033 with ink numbers, unanswered squares outline-only with secondary numbers, two flagged squares with amber border and amber number, the current square (14) ringed in emerald. Under the grid a one-line legend with small swatches: Answered, Flagged, Current. In the bottom bar the flag button reads "Flagged" and is active with an amber outline and amber text.
Bottom: a thumb-zone action bar docked to the bottom edge above the home indicator, canvas with a hairline top edge, three buttons in one row 56px tall: "Previous" (quiet, raised #182033 fill, narrow), "Flag" with a small flag icon (quiet, narrow), and a dominant wide emerald "Next" button (filled #10b981 with near-black text, takes about half the width). No tab bar on this screen.
